text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGE: production-edge-routing (severity P1) - elevated 5xx and request timeouts for ~20% of traffic in ap-southeast-1. Pager: @oncall.

Alex: seeing 5xx spike starting ~2034567880, looks correlated with last deploy to edge routing service (canary -> 30% weight).

Meera: confirming, dashboards show increased origin errors and TLS handshakes failing at the edge layer. Canary weight change logged at 2034567812 by deploy-bot.

Sam: tagging routing team. @Tara can you pick this up? if it's routing config drift we should flip the traffic back to blue.

Tara: I'm on it. grabbing `kubectl` to check ConfigMap for `edge-weights`.

Tara: quick dump: `edge-weights: { ap-southeast-1: {blue: 70, green: 30}, eu-west-1: {blue: 90, green: 10} }` — that matches the intended rollout.

Jordan: but DNS weight for ap-southeast-1 shows `green` at 60% from global LB. that mismatch could explain it.

Leah: how are we surfacing LB vs service weights? I remember we had a split control plane (service mesh vs infra LB) and one side didn't get the change.

Alex: yep that's the hypothesis: the canary config pushed to service control plane but the external LB rollout failed due to a stale job. So some traffic reaches green nodes which have a runtime dependency missing (new cert rotation behavior), causing TLS errors.

Meera: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (kill-switch) at service control plane, 2) reduce LB weight for green to 0, 3) if needed rollback image on green to previous stable.

Sam: agree. Tara, do you have a quick command to set LB weight to 0 for ap-southeast?

Tara: running infractl now:  `infractl lb update-weight --region ap-southeast-1 --pool green --weight 0`

IncidentBot: deploy-bot noticed `infractl` job queued at 2034567920.

Tara: LB update returned success at 2034567935. Current global LB status: `ap-southeast-1: blue 100, green 0`

Jordan: service control plane still has `green` at 30 though. need to pause further rollouts to avoid reintroducing.

Meera: invoking feature flag kill-switch: `ffctl set edge_routing_canary false --scope global` (meant to prevent any new green rollouts). Executed at 2034567940.

Alex: good. starting health check: synthetic traffic to ap-southeast edge is now showing error rate dropping.

Leah: customer impact? any active incidents reported from big customers?

Sam: quick check with support: two customer-reported timeouts in APAC, both recovered after ~2 minutes. No major data loss.

Tara: rolling back green image as extra precaution: `k8s rollout undo deployment/edge-service -n prod --to-revision=23` for green pool at 2034568002.

IncidentBot: k8s-bot reports rollback started; events: PodTermination for green nodes.

Jordan: logs show TLS cert validation error in new image: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` — that matches missing cert bundle in new runtime. confirmed root cause.

Meera: root cause summary: a runtime change in the new canary image expects an updated cert bundle (packaged via separate job). Deployment to green pool occurred but the cert-bundle job failed earlier in the pipeline for ap-southeast, causing green to be unhealthy under real traffic. Control plane and LB weights were briefly inconsistent which amplified user impact.

Alex: remediation steps completed: LB weights set to blue 100, feature flag kill-switch enabled, green image rolled back. Monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline.

Sam: on-call handoff: Meera (primary) will monitor for 2 hours, then hand off to Jordan at +2h if stable. Will open a post-incident issue with action items.

Leah: action items to track in issue: 1) make cert-bundle job required before image promotion, 2) add automated verification that LB weights match service control plane after rollouts, 3) improve canary health check to include TLS handshake test, 4) add synthetic customer probes in APAC to alert faster.

Tara: I'll add runbook steps for `infractl lb update-weight` and `ffctl` kill-switch with exact commands and RBAC notes.

Meera: I'll draft timeline + RC (root cause) and attach logs. Adding impacted customers list from support.

Alex: excellent. postmortem ping @eng-postmortems channel once draft is ready. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Incident resolved at 2034568300. Severity downgraded to P3.

Sam: closing loop — had one lingering 504 at 2034568420 from a long-tail retry, but overall traffic normalized.

Meera: handing to Jordan now for monitoring handoff. Jordan: you have the floor.

Jordan: taking over monitoring. will keep `~edge-alert` on and escalate if any regressions. Thanks team.

Leah: thanks all, great coordination.
